from decimal import Decimal, getcontext
getcontext().prec = 50
rows=[]
with open('/workspace/codex_tmp/joined.tabular', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
    for line in fh:
        fields=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')

        chrom, count, joined_chrom, length = fields
        assert chrom == joined_chrom
        assert int(count) > 0 and int(length) > 0
        rows.append((chrom, int(count), int(length)))
assert len(rows) == 20
mean = sum((Decimal(count) / Decimal(length) for _, count, length in rows), Decimal(0)) / Decimal(len(rows))
print('n=', len(rows))
for chrom,count,length in rows:
    print(chrom, count, length, Decimal(count)/Decimal(length))
print('mean=', mean)
PY"
